description: See a Smart+ ad as it renders on TikTok, before or after it exists. Pass smartPlusAdId for an existing Smart+ ad, OR the fields create_tiktok_smart_ad takes to preview one you have not created yet: creatives (each with identity_type and identity_id from list_tiktok_ads_identities, which TikTok requires here), adTexts, callToActions, adConfiguration (the catalog_tag_list of an inventory card goes inside its product info object), interactiveAddOnCardId, and disclaimerText or disclaimerLinks. For a catalog ad add catalogEnabled, catalogId and catalogAuthorizedBcId. Up to 31 creatives. Returns a preview link TikTok keeps for 30 days. Creates nothing and spends nothing.

adConfiguration.description: TikTok ad_configuration for Spark or catalog ads

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

callToActions.description: up to 3 TikTok call-to-action enums; the preview shows the first

catalogAuthorizedBcId.description: the Business Center that owns catalogId

creatives.description: up to 31 TikTok creative_info objects: {ad_format, video_info: {video_id}, image_info: [{web_uri}], tiktok_item_id, identity_type, identity_id, music_info}

disclaimerLinks.description: OR up to 3 clickable disclaimers; their texts may total 40 characters

disclaimerText.description: a text disclaimer, up to 90 characters

interactiveAddOnCardId.description: ONE interactive add-on card id: a Display Card, Countdown or Gift Code Sticker, or an Inventory Card

smartPlusAdId.description: preview an existing Smart+ ad; omit to preview a planned one

name: preview_tiktok_smart_ad
title: Preview a TikTok Smart+ ad
